meta.title: Privacy
meta.description: Privacy policy of Moritz Hecht – Invessiv.

page.title: Privacy Policy
page.lead: This policy explains what personal data I process, why I process it, and how I handle it on this website.

hosting.title: 2. Hosting and server logs
hosting.body: When visiting this website, the hosting provider processes technically required connection data (for example IP address, timestamp, user-agent, referrer, requested resource) to ensure service stability and abuse prevention. Legal basis: Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR.

contactRequests.title: 3. Contact requests and project inquiries
contactRequests.body: If you contact me by email, phone, or project inquiry, I process your information (for example name, email, company, requested service, and project description) to handle your request and related follow-ups. The project form opens a prefilled email in your mail client. Legal basis: Art. 6 para. 1 lit. b GDPR (pre-contractual communication) and Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR (efficient handling of customer requests). AI tools may be used to support internal draft structuring. Personal data is only processed in that context where required for handling your request and where legally permissible. I retain this data only as long as required for request handling and legal documentation duties. For appointment scheduling I use the external service Calendly (Calendly LLC). When you click the scheduling link or book a slot, data is transmitted to Calendly and processed there. Calendly privacy information applies: https://calendly.com/legal/privacy-notice.

cookies.title: 4. Cookies and similar technologies
cookies.body: This website currently uses only technically required functionality. Tracking or marketing cookies are not used at this time.

rights.title: 5. Your rights
rights.body: Under the GDPR you have rights including access, rectification, erasure, restriction, data portability and objection.
